# Known Stylus-Compatible Crates
#
# These crates have been verified to work with Arbitrum Stylus contracts.
# Each entry documents the compatibility status and any special configuration
# needed (e.g., disabling default features).
#
# To add a crate: copy a [[crate]] block, fill in the fields, and open a PR.
# See CONTRIBUTING.md for guidelines.

# --- Stylus SDK & Ecosystem ---

[[crate]]
name = "stylus-sdk"
requires_std = false
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "Official Stylus SDK — the foundation for all Stylus contracts"

[[crate]]
name = "alloy-primitives"
requires_std = false
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "Ethereum primitive types (Address, U256, B256). Use default-features = false"

[[crate]]
name = "alloy-sol-types"
requires_std = false
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "Solidity type encoding/decoding. Use default-features = false"

# --- Cryptography ---

[[crate]]
name = "tiny-keccak"
requires_std = false
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "Pure Rust keccak256 — recommended by Arbitrum docs"

[[crate]]
name = "sha2"
requires_std = false
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "SHA-256/SHA-512. Use default-features = false"

[[crate]]
name = "sha3"
requires_std = false
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "SHA-3/Keccak. Use default-features = false"

[[crate]]
name = "k256"
requires_std = false
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "secp256k1 curve operations. Use default-features = false"

[[crate]]
name = "p256"
requires_std = false
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "NIST P-256 curve. Use default-features = false"

# --- Serialization ---

[[crate]]
name = "serde"
requires_std = false
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "Use default-features = false, features = [\"derive\"]"

[[crate]]
name = "serde-json-core"
requires_std = false
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "no_std JSON parser — alternative to serde_json"

[[crate]]
name = "borsh"
requires_std = false
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "Binary serialization. Use default-features = false"

[[crate]]
name = "ciborium"
requires_std = false
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "CBOR encoding/decoding for no_std"

# --- Math & Data Structures ---

[[crate]]
name = "ruint"
requires_std = false
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "Fixed-size unsigned integers (U256, etc.)"

[[crate]]
name = "fixed"
requires_std = false
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "Fixed-point arithmetic — no floats needed"

[[crate]]
name = "uint"
requires_std = false
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "256-bit and other large integers"

[[crate]]
name = "arrayvec"
requires_std = false
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "Fixed-capacity Vec alternative for no_std"

[[crate]]
name = "heapless"
requires_std = false
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "Static-friendly data structures (Vec, String, Map) without alloc"

[[crate]]
name = "smallvec"
requires_std = false
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "Stack-allocated small vectors. Use default-features = false"

# --- Encoding ---

[[crate]]
name = "hex"
requires_std = false
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "Hex encoding/decoding. Use default-features = false"

[[crate]]
name = "base64"
requires_std = false
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "Base64 encoding. Use default-features = false"

[[crate]]
name = "bs58"
requires_std = false
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "Base58 encoding. Use default-features = false"

# --- Utilities ---

[[crate]]
name = "bytes"
requires_std = false
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "Byte buffer utilities. Use default-features = false"

[[crate]]
name = "bitflags"
requires_std = false
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "Type-safe bitflags"

[[crate]]
name = "cfg-if"
requires_std = false
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "Conditional compilation helper — zero-cost"

[[crate]]
name = "static_assertions"
requires_std = false
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "Compile-time assertions — zero runtime cost"

# Known Stylus-Incompatible Crates
#
# These crates cannot be used in Stylus contracts due to std requirements,
# floating-point usage, async runtimes, or OS-level dependencies.
#
# Each entry includes the reason for incompatibility and a suggested alternative
# where one exists.
#
# To update: open a PR with evidence (e.g., link to the crate's Cargo.toml
# showing the std dependency, or a compilation error log).

# --- Async Runtimes ---

[[crate]]
name = "tokio"
requires_std = true
has_float = false
has_async = true
notes = "Async runtime — requires std, threads, I/O polling"

[[crate]]
name = "async-std"
requires_std = true
has_float = false
has_async = true
notes = "Async runtime — requires std"

[[crate]]
name = "smol"
requires_std = true
has_float = false
has_async = true
notes = "Async runtime — requires std"

# --- Networking ---

[[crate]]
name = "reqwest"
requires_std = true
has_float = false
has_async = true
alternative = "N/A — no HTTP client is possible in WASM contracts"
notes = "HTTP client — requires networking, TLS, async"

[[crate]]
name = "hyper"
requires_std = true
has_float = false
has_async = true
notes = "HTTP library — requires std, tokio"

# --- Serialization (std-only) ---

[[crate]]
name = "serde_json"
requires_std = true
has_float = true
has_async = false
alternative = "serde-json-core"
notes = "Uses std::io for formatting. Use serde-json-core for no_std JSON"

[[crate]]
name = "serde_yaml"
requires_std = true
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "YAML parsing requires std"

[[crate]]
name = "toml"
requires_std = true
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "TOML parsing requires std"

# --- Database ---

[[crate]]
name = "diesel"
requires_std = true
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "ORM — requires std, libc, database drivers"

[[crate]]
name = "sqlx"
requires_std = true
has_float = false
has_async = true
notes = "Async SQL toolkit — requires std, networking"

[[crate]]
name = "rusqlite"
requires_std = true
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "SQLite bindings — requires libc, filesystem"

# --- OS-Dependent ---

[[crate]]
name = "libc"
requires_std = true
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "Raw FFI bindings to platform C library — no WASM equivalent"

[[crate]]
name = "nix"
requires_std = true
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "Unix API bindings — requires libc"

[[crate]]
name = "mio"
requires_std = true
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "I/O event loop — requires OS-level polling (epoll/kqueue)"

[[crate]]
name = "native-tls"
requires_std = true
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "TLS via OS libraries — no WASM equivalent"

[[crate]]
name = "openssl"
requires_std = true
has_float = false
has_async = false
alternative = "Use pure-Rust crypto crates (sha2, k256, etc.)"
notes = "OpenSSL bindings — requires libc, system libraries"

# --- Floating-Point Heavy ---

[[crate]]
name = "num"
requires_std = false
has_float = true
has_async = false
alternative = "ruint, fixed, uint"
notes = "Default features include float types — Stylus disallows f32/f64"

[[crate]]
name = "nalgebra"
requires_std = false
has_float = true
has_async = false
alternative = "fixed (for fixed-point arithmetic)"
notes = "Linear algebra library — heavily uses f32/f64"

[[crate]]
name = "rand"
requires_std = true
has_float = true
has_async = false
notes = "RNG — uses floats for distributions, requires OS entropy source"

# --- Web Frameworks ---

[[crate]]
name = "actix-web"
requires_std = true
has_float = false
has_async = true
notes = "Web framework — requires networking, async, OS APIs"

[[crate]]
name = "rocket"
requires_std = true
has_float = false
has_async = true
notes = "Web framework — requires networking, async, OS APIs"

[[crate]]
name = "axum"
requires_std = true
has_float = false
has_async = true
notes = "Web framework — requires tokio, hyper, networking"

# --- Logging (std-only) ---

[[crate]]
name = "env_logger"
requires_std = true
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "Requires std::env and std::io"

[[crate]]
name = "tracing-subscriber"
requires_std = true
has_float = false
has_async = false
notes = "Requires std for I/O and threading"

# --- SIMD ---

[[crate]]
name = "packed_simd"
requires_std = false
has_float = true
has_async = false
notes = "Portable SIMD types, nightly-only via #![feature(...)]. Stylus rejects v128 opcodes"

[[crate]]
name = "packed_simd_2"
requires_std = false
has_float = true
has_async = false
notes = "Maintained fork of packed_simd, same nightly requirement and same v128 output"

[[crate]]
name = "wide"
requires_std = false
has_float = true
has_async = false
notes = "Emits v128 only under target_feature simd128, otherwise scalar. Float types either way"

[[crate]]
name = "simdeez"
requires_std = true
has_float = true
has_async = false
notes = "no_std only behind its no_std feature. x86 engines plus a wasm32 simd128 engine"

[[crate]]
name = "ultraviolet"
requires_std = true
has_float = true
has_async = false
alternative = "fixed (for fixed-point arithmetic)"
notes = "3D math built on wide, no no_std support"
